The '''Flail hideout''' was located on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was the headquarters of [[the Flail]],<ref name="SWG:CvFB" /> a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization that appeared on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].<ref name="SoC">{{WizCite|book=Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook|story=Shadows of Coruscant}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Corellian Security Force]] finally discovered the location of the Flail hideout. CorSec troops and Flail cutthroats then [[CorSec vs. Flail Battle|battled]] in the valley leading to the hideout.<ref name="SWG:CvFB" />
